headline: Syr wins SM Match by Upfront at The National
blurb: Sebastian Eidsæther Syr won the SM Match by Upfront at The National Golfresort, beating Oliver Lilliedahl 3 & 1 in the final of the 64-player match play knockout.
body:
[Sebastian Eidsæther Syr](/sebastian-eidsather-syr) won the SM Match by Upfront at The National Golfresort, beating [Oliver Lilliedahl](/oliver-lilliedahl) 3 & 1 in the final on July 10. Syr controlled the final match and closed it out on the 17th hole with a three-hole lead. The three-day tournament had 64 players competing in a match play knockout format.

Syr was strong throughout the week. He opened with a 3 & 2 win over [Max Risvåg](/max-risvag), then beat [Fabian Wennerlöf](/fabian-wennerlof) 6 & 5 in the second round — his biggest win of the week. In the third round he beat [Jesper Hagborg Asp](/jesper-hagborg-asp) 2 & 1, and in the quarter-final he defeated [Christian Jacobsen](/christian-jacobsen) 4 & 2. The semi-final against [Sebastian Petersen](/sebastian-petersen) was his closest match. Syr won it 1 up after all 18 holes were played.

Lilliedahl had a good run through the bracket but could not match Syr in the final. The two losing semi-finalists were Petersen and [Thom Hoetmer](/thom-hoetmer), who were both knocked out in the last four.

Correction: An earlier version of this article incorrectly named Oliver Lilliedahl as the winner of the final. This was caused by a data error on our side. Sebastian Eidsæther Syr won the final 3 & 1. We are sorry for the mistake.
